card.name: The word after in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "after" right after a route or administration phrase, such as "intravenous infusion after" or "IM or IV after", where a preparation step like dilution or reconstitution follows.

modes.label: After a preparation step
modes.description: "after" follows an administration route and leads into dilution or reconstitution.
modes.example: Administer as an intravenous infusion<< after>> dilution.

modes.label: After in clinical steps
modes.description: "after" follows a procedure or dose step and leads into another event or precaution.
modes.example: Endotracheal intubation, employing drugs and techniques familiar to the clinician, may be indicated,<< after>> initial administration of oxygen by mask, if

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like check, verify and checking, and away from unrelated tokens.
